observations: Professional product photograph of a DSLR camera.
The camera body is covered by a black silicone protective skin.
The brand 'Canon' is visible on the front of the camera in photo 0.
The model '5D Mark IV' is visible on the front badge in photo 0.
The lens is a Canon EF 24-105mm f/4L IS USM, identified in photo 0.
Watermarks 'ZOYERICH ENTERPRISE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible across the image.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the correct model but is a professional stock image, not a photo of the actual item being sold.

risks.risk: The photo is a stock image and the seller may not possess the item.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera next to a handwritten note with the current date and seller's name.

risks.risk: The silicone skin may be hiding significant cosmetic damage or heavy wear on the body.
risks.proof: Photos of the camera body with the silicone skin removed.

risks.risk: The camera may have a very high shutter count or internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the camera operating and a screenshot of the shutter count.
A clear photo of the sensor with the lens removed.

proof_requests: A photo of the actual camera and lens with a handwritten note showing today's date and your name.
Photos of the camera body from all sides with the silicone skin removed.
A video showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
A screenshot or photo showing the shutter count.
response.reason: The use of a professional stock photo with a business watermark instead of original photos of the actual item is a major red flag for a scam, especially for high-value electronics.
